dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Okay, I've got other things to do...

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: What? You look surprised. Never seen a blacksmith play cards before?

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Whoa... for you to be able to catch such a small mistake...

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: It seems I'm good with cards as well as a hammer and anvil. Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Traveler, do you have a moment?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Have you heard of Stormterror's Lair? It's those ruins outside Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: While Stormterror made the place his home, it was shrouded in a whirling, impassable storm. No one could pass through, so the precious crystal ore in there hasn't been mined.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: I've heard people say that the storm around the area has disappeared. That should have been a prime moment to go for the ore veins...

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: ...But with so many places in the city needing repairs, our smithy's services are in high demand. Schulz can't hold the fort down alone either, so I can't leave.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: What say you go have a look, Traveler? If you find any crystal ore, bring some back with you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm on the case.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: My thanks. These crystal ores should help in forging and in restoring the city as well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have other things to do...

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: That's no issue. We aren't in a rush. When I have time, I'll check it out myself.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: What do you have to sell?

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Take your pick. You'll find no second-rate items at Wagner's.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to ask about something.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Well, spit it out already.

response.speaker: Wagner
response.text: Stupid question. If you really want to know, buy something.

response.speaker: Wagner
response.text: Talk is cheap. Pick up a blade and you'll soon know.

response.speaker: Wagner
response.text: If even this much eludes you, then you've got a long road ahead of you, runt.

response.speaker: Wagner
response.text: There are no other qualified blacksmiths here, except for me and my apprentice, Schulz.

response.speaker: Wagner
response.text: I can tell you from experience that hard work is all there is to the craft! Many other "blacksmiths" out there are just out to make a quick mora!

response.speaker: Wagner
response.text: Family? Inheritance? Meaningless! I only need an apprentice to pass on my skills.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: If there's nothing else, get going. I'm busy.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>What do you sell here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Take your pick. You'll find no second-rate items at Wagner's.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like something made.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Did you bring the materials? Let me have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: What? Speak up, I can't hear you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you going to find shelter?

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Shelter? It'd take a much bigger storm than this to keep me away from my blacksmith's...

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: The wrought iron here spends all day getting hammered into shape.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: People, on the other hand, don't get that chance as often — so make the most of it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>I'd like something made.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: That reminds me — your order from last time is ready. Is that what you wanted, or is this a new request?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: There's nothing to be said. Dragon or no dragon, I'll be here.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: As long as there's life in me, the fires of Wagner's smithy will not go out.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Smithing is not dependent on brute strength. You need the sweat on your brow from constant hard work, and perseverance stronger than the metals we forge!

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: The tempest is precisely the time to practice perseverance. If one were to be terrified at a little wind, then forging a respectable weapon is simply out of the question!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any tips on finding ore in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Nope.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: Not if you've already exhausted the sources I told you about.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: If you're that desperate for more, I'm sorry but that's your problem. We can discuss it another time, but I'm busy right now.
